definitions.gloss: carsickness; getting sick from riding in a car
definitions.explanation: Nausea and dizziness caused by the motion of a car. The verb form {車酔|くるまよ}いする means "to get carsick."

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{車酔|くるまよ}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{車酔|くるまよ}いしやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧おく。
examples.english: I get carsick easily, so I take medicine beforehand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{車酔|くるまよ}い⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: There were so many curves on the mountain road that I got carsick.

notes:
Part of a family of motion sickness compounds using ～{酔|よ}い:
- {車酔|くるまよ}い (carsickness)
- ⟦{船酔|ふなよ}い→船酔い：30619_funayoi⟧ (seasickness)
- {飛行機酔|ひこうきよ}い (airsickness)
- ⟦{乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}い→乗り物酔い：25234_norimonoyoi⟧ (motion sickness — general term)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車酔|くるまよ}いしやすい (prone to carsickness)
- {車酔|くるまよ}い{止|ど}め (carsickness medicine)
- {車酔|くるまよ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine for carsickness)

TIP: To say "I get carsick easily," say {車酔|くるまよ}いしやすい (not {車酔|くるまよ}いがしやすい).
